units.source_text: 但是，X型的腿会突然出来制止我。

en.t: But the X-shaped legs would suddenly appear and stop me.

units.source_text: 只有这双腿决不会变成透明的。

en.t: Only these legs would never become transparent.

units.source_text: 与其说它是腿，莫如说是一种顽固的精神。

en.t: Rather than legs, they were a kind of stubborn spirit.

units.source_text: 它作为比肉体更为坚定的"东西"而在那里存在着。

en.t: They existed there as something more steadfast than the body.
